Review of shift_weekly (request_changes): The current implementation does not handle intervals that wrap around the end of the week correctly. It calculates a single `new_day` based on the start time, but if the shifted interval spans across the week boundary, the end time will be on a different day (or the start of the week). The function should likely split such intervals into two separate entries or correctly handle the day wrap-around for the end time. As it stands, the result is a single tuple that may represent an impossible shift (e.g., starting on Sunday and ending on Monday but labeled as Sunday).
